extracted.name: Quick Tartar Sauce
extracted.description: Whip up this easy tartar sauce with mayonnaise, lemon juice, and sweet pickle relish when you're in a hurry.
instruction_lines: Add mayonnaise, relish, mustard (if using), and lemon juice together in a bowl.
Serve immediately or refrigerate the sauce until ready to serve.
